# Vladimir Hlobchastyi — Senior Software Engineer

> Vladimir Hlobchastyi is a Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of commercial experience. He helps product teams understand complex requirements, clarify business rules and user flows, and deliver reliable web and mobile features through release.

## Focus
- Frontend architecture and product interfaces with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
- Cross-platform mobile delivery with React Native and Ionic.
- Product work across APIs, integrations, and Node.js services.
- AI-assisted development, including reviewing and stabilizing AI-generated codebases.
- Independent mobile product development, from game rules and progression to a published Android release.
- Working languages: English (B2), Ukrainian and Russian (native).

## Selected case studies
- [Retro Lines](/work/retro-lines) — independently designed and published Android puzzle game built with React Native.
- [Clinical Learning Platform](/work/clinical-education-platform) — recovery and restructuring of an AI-generated frontend codebase.
- [Freight Rate Platform](/work/logistics-management-platform) — carrier pricing, route search, and shipment booking workflows.
- [Property Marketplace](/work/real-estate-platform) — property search, comparison, listings, and enquiry flows.
- [Social Media App](/work/social-network-mobile-app) — mobile feed, stories, messaging, calls, and subscriptions.
- [Mental Health Support App](/work/mental-health-mobile-app) — confidential realtime support and communication flows.
